name: AuthTokenType
doc: Represents some (custom) token type used by the documented API.

props.doc: ID of the API where this token type is used.

props.name: nameNoSpaces
props.doc: A lowercase copy of this token's name with all whitespaces removed. Used for indexing and search.

props.name: useType
props.doc: Determines how this token is applied.

name: Scope
doc: Represents an authorization scope in the documented API.

props.doc: ID of the API where this scope is used.
